description: This file defines a React component for viewing and editing information related to a specific Key object, including display of metadata, key management actions (regenerate, delete), and detailed settings/overview panels.

methods.name: handleKeyUpdate
methods.description: Handles form submission to update key data by calling API, updating local state, and triggering callback.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the key by calling API and handling UI updates.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies specified text to clipboard and provides visual feedback.

methods.name: handleRegenerateKeyUpdate
methods.description: Updates local state and notifies parent when key is regenerated.

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Formats date/time string into a human-readable style.
